title: Schedule of Benefits for Northgate Care Protection Plans
content:
This schedule sets, plan by plan, what a Northgate Care Protection Plans contract pays on a covered claim: the limit of liability, the repair count after which a failure is settled by replacement, what a replacement and a cash settlement are, the accidental damage allowance and deductible, the food spoilage allowance, and whether a replacement or cash settlement ends the plan. A figure of 0 or 0.00 marks a benefit the plan does not carry.

## Benefits common to all six plans

| Benefit | Every Northgate Care plan |
|---|---|
| Limit of liability (what caps all claims paid on the plan) | the covered product's price |
| Repairs of the same failure after which the next failure is settled by replacement | 3 |
| What a replacement is | a comparable new model, up to the remaining limit of liability |
| How a cash settlement is valued | the remaining limit of liability |
| A replacement or cash settlement fulfills and ends the plan | Yes |

## Benefits that differ by plan

| Plan | Accidental damage claims allowed over the term | Deductible per accidental damage claim (USD) | Food spoilage reimbursement for a covered refrigerator or freezer failure (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | 2 | 49.00 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 250.00 |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 500.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The accidental damage allowance of 2 claims over the term and the 49.00 deductible per accidental damage claim belong to the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection alone.
2. Food spoilage reimbursement is carried only by the appliance plans: up to 250.00 under the Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan and up to 500.00 under the Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan.
3. The limit of liability is the price paid for the covered product on its sale line. As a hypothetical illustration, a product bought for 1200.00 carries a limit of liability of 1200.00 under whichever Northgate Care plan covers it.
